_note: Authoring benchmark for the conversational agent (engine/agent_bench.py). Each task is a fixed prompt the agent must turn into a delivered, passing test case. tc_id/flow_id are DICTATED so scoring and cleanup are deterministic; every flow is prefixed bench_ (the bench only ever deletes flows/bench_*). Difficulty spread: easy = sanity floor (should stay ~100%), medium = real user flows, hard = the known failure modes (scroll-to-find, modals end-to-end, admin MUI autocomplete, vague wording). Run: venv\Scripts\python engine\agent_bench.py

Create a test that opens the Orders page and verifies it loads with the order stats summary visible at the top. Save it as test case TC-BENCH-002 in flow bench_orders, verify it passes, then stop.

tasks.probe: PRD-driven negotiated-cart epic: create+close a SUPPLY negotiation ticket, thread its number into the cart, customer/SKU/seller autocompletes, master-pack qty validation, Credit payment, save-as-draft
tasks.prompt:
The complete cart-to-dispatch business flow is documented in the context file COMPLETE_LLM_FLOW_CART_TO_DISPATCH.md - read PHASE 1 (cart creation), especially Step 7 (negotiation tickets), before driving anything. This is a TWO-PART flow on the admin panel.

PART A - Supply negotiation ticket: open the Negotiations module and create a SUPPLY negotiation ticket with: customer 'SUPERTECH LIMITED', SKU 'Testing Ajay Seeds Nantes Testing Ajay Seeds 1.5 Ltr Printed 1.2LTR', and seller 'M&M_Brand1' (the supplier for the special negotiated cost). Fill any required amounts with reasonable values. NOTE THE TICKET NUMBER the system assigns, then CLOSE the ticket - the cart only accepts closed tickets.

PART B - Cart with the ticket: open the cart creation form (OMS > Carts > create); select customer 'SUPERTECH LIMITED' via the customer autocomplete; provide a shipping address (saved one if available, else add new); add the SKU 'Testing Ajay Seeds Nantes Testing Ajay Seeds 1.5 Ltr Printed 1.2LTR' with a quantity that satisfies the master-pack multiple rule (read and react to any quantity validation error); in the negotiation/discount section enter the ticket number from PART A and apply it - verify the supply discount is applied; select the CREDIT payment method; save the cart as Draft and verify it reaches Draft status. Do NOT send the cart to the customer - that triggers a real SMS/OTP.

Save it as test case TC-BENCH-011 in flow bench_cart, verify it passes, then stop. NOTE: each authoring run creates a FRESH ticket; the recorded test will carry the ticket number captured during authoring - if the replay rejects ticket reuse, report that honestly rather than hiding it.
tasks._feasibility: phases 2-4 of the doc (customer OTP, payment, finance approval) are NOT unattended-automatable; this covers the directed admin half incl. the negotiation-ticket dependency. Dynamic data caveat: the ticket number is generated per run - replay validity depends on the app's closed-ticket reuse rules; if reuse is rejected this epic exposes the capture-and-reuse codegen gap (a known product-level limitation worth measuring).

tasks.probe: PRD-driven stateful lifecycle epic: PO accept -> pack with file upload; each run CONSUMES an Issued PO, so the test must be authored generically (first PO in the Issued tab)
tasks.prompt: Read PHASE 6 (purchase order lifecycle) of the context file COMPLETE_LLM_FLOW_CART_TO_DISPATCH.md before driving anything. On the Seller App, create a test for the PO accept-and-pack lifecycle slice: open Purchase Orders, switch to the 'Issued' status tab, open the FIRST issued PO's detail page, click Accept and confirm in the dialog, verify the order timeline marks Accepted; then click 'Mark as Packed' and complete the pack form - it requires a ready-proof image, use the upload_file tool with the standard test image - and verify the PO status becomes Packed. IMPORTANT: accepting a PO consumes it (it leaves the Issued tab), so author the test against the FIRST PO in the Issued tab generically, never a hardcoded PO number. If NO issued PO exists on dev right now, say so and deliver a test covering the deepest step that is reachable. Save it as test case TC-BENCH-012 in flow bench_po, verify it passes, then stop.
tasks._feasibility: data-dependent: needs Issued POs on dev (the orders suite and admin runs create them). State-mutating by nature - exactly the hard reality this epic tier measures.
